description:
Teleport Connect provides easy and secure access to SSH servers, databases, applications, Windows desktops, and Kubernetes clusters.


This is a follow up to the 18.10.1 private security release that includes an additional non-security improvement:
- Added synchronization that mitigates an issue where concurrent tsh proxy ssh invocations open an excessive number of browser tabs for reauthentication when tsh credentials expire. #68897
Note: 18.10.5 release was skipped due to internal CI/CD issue.
